sentences.text: GP MUNCIPAL ADMN AND URBAN DEV AP

The Court made the following:
ORDER:
Heard Sri Shaik Asif, learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Assistant Government Pleader for Municipal Administration and Urban Development appearing for the respondents.

2. It is stated by both the learned counsel that the issue raised in the Writ Petition is squarely covered by the order passed by this Court in W.P.No.21175 of 2025, and thus prays the Court for passing of the same order in the present case.
3. The Writ Petition is accordingly disposed of, in terms of the orders passed by this Court in W.P.No.21175 of 2025, dated 08.09.2025.
There shall be no order as to costs.
4. Registry is directed to append a copy of the order in W.P.No.21175 of 2025, dated 08.09.2025 to this order.
As a sequel, all pending miscellaneous applications shall stand closed.
JUSTICE KIRANMAYEE MANDAVA Date:26.09.2025 MVK THE HONOURABLE SMT JUSTICE KIRANMAYEE MANDAVA WRIT PETITION NO:26972 of 2025 Date:26.09.2025
